scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p build/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck:upstream
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node build/run.ts build
scripts.package:dir: npm run build:release && node build/run.ts package
scripts.build:release: npm run check:product && npm run typecheck && node build/run.ts build:release
scripts.start: npm run build && node build/run.ts start
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:native && node build/run.ts test:ui
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:css
scripts.check: npm run check:product && npm run check:upstream && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:tooling
scripts.precommit: npm run check && cargo fmt --all -- --check && npm test
scripts.package:installers: npm run package:dir && node build/run.ts package:installers
